time.note: Engine timing (SPEC-v3 §3, the dispatch model), whole ms of engine time. A sapper sent at a pixel pops it yardMs + tiles x tileMs + biteMs later (tiles = its walk distance + 1) and is home yardMs + tiles x carryMs after that; a space sends one sapper every staggerMs; an archer hit lands halfway out and the sapper is back knockMs plus the walk later. The ratios shape which pixels squads claim, so changing them needs a rebake. To slow or speed the whole game without changing any outcome, turn show.pace instead. v4 M3 (the swarm): staggerMs 120 -> 30 so a big squad pours out (55 sappers leave in 1.6 s, not 6.6 s), biteMs 180 -> 100 and yardMs 250 -> 200 (less standing per block); the walk (tileMs, carryMs) is Peter's and unchanged.

levels.name: Open Gate
levels.hint: Tap a squad. Its sappers come out at the bottom and each eats the nearest block of their colour.

levels.name: The Waiting Line
levels.hint: Sappers who can't reach their colour wait on the holding line, and march on their own once it opens up.

levels.name: Woodpile
levels.hint: A squad bigger than what's open eats what it can reach. The rest wait, then finish the job.

levels.name: The Open Bridge
levels.hint: Sappers can't cross water. The drawbridge is down: everything over the moat is reached across the bridge.

levels.name: The Locked Gate
levels.hint: A locked gate bars the way in. Dig out its gold key and send the Looters: the key opens the gate.

levels.name: Linked Squads
levels.hint: Linked squads go out together: both must be at the front, with 2 free spaces. Both spaces free once both squads have picked up their last blocks.

levels.name: Hidden Colours
levels.hint: A ? squad hides its colour until it reaches the front. Its count always shows.
